name: Cyclo-Methiodrone
summary: Empathogen with strong stimulant effects, very loosely related to benzylpiperidine.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

fact.en: 4-Benzylpiperidine, the simple molecule it is loosely related to, releases dopamine and noradrenaline. A benzylpiperidine group also forms part of the Alzheimer's drug donepezil.
fact.zh: 它所鬆散相關的簡單分子 4-苄基哌啶，會促使多巴胺與正腎上腺素釋放。苄基哌啶結構也出現在阿茲海默症藥物多奈哌齊中。
fact.zhHans: 它所松散相关的简单分子 4-苄基哌啶，会促使多巴胺与正肾上腺素释放。苄基哌啶结构也出现在阿兹海默症药物多奈哌齐中。
